validation), 403 (not the caller's action), 404 (missing, hidden or unknown action), 409 (not allowed from the
current status, required attachments missing, a concurrent change).

when the record already holds the type's most files.

post.summary:

step; 404; 409 `ATTACHMENTS_REQUIRED_MISSING` or `RECORDS_NOT_SUBMITTABLE`.

roles.description: The ordinary roles the user holds after the write.

permissions.description: The direct grants the user holds after the write.

confirmBreakGlassOnly.description:
True accepts that the write leaves only the break-glass administrator able to manage access (otherwise refused
with string AccessErrorCodes.LastManager).

PutUserGrantsCommand.description:
The body of `PUT /api/admin/access/users/{userId}/grants`: the user's complete set of roles and direct grants
(replaces both), validated by PutUserGrantsValidator. A role or key listed twice keeps its widest
scope.

state.description: On track (1), due soon (2) or breached (3).

dueAt.description: The deadline of the current status.

ReasonRequirement.description: Whether a transition takes a reason from the actor. Values are sent on the wire; never renumber a member.

RecordAssigneeResponse.description: Who currently works on the record.

fileName.description: The file name as uploaded (sanitized by the attachment service).

contentType.description: The MIME type (from the extension, never from the client).

RecordAttachmentResponse.description: One live attachment of a record (list item and the 201 body of a link).

items.description: The live attachments, ordered by upload time.

missingRequiredTypeKeys.description: The required types with no attachment yet (the interlock's answer).

wording.description: The status wording keys of every audience.

audience.description: How the caller sees the record (1 requester, 2 staff, 3 admin).

lastReason.description: The reason of the latest timeline entry, or null.

allowedActions.description: What the caller may do now (empty when terminal and for oversight).

oneOf.description: The current assignee, or null.
The SLA badge, or null.

attachableRecordType.description: The record type of its attachment routes.

attachmentsRecordId.description: The record id in the attachment routes' family (`attachable-records`).

number.description: The reference number, or null until submitted.

submittedAt.description: When it was first submitted, or null.

ownerDisplayName.description: The owner's display name (oversight only; null in `mine`).

RecordPageResponseOfRecordListItemRespon.description: A page of a list endpoint (`page` is 1-based).

dueAt.description: When the current status is due.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token from the login or the previous refresh.

RejectedImportRowResponse.description: A row the commit left out.

sections.description: Every section the page should hold (at most int PortalLimits.MaxSectionsPerPage; may be empty).

ReplacePortalContentCommand.description:
The body of `PUT /api/admin/portal/content/{page}`: the page's complete list of sections. A section with an
id updates that section, one without an id is added, and a section of the page that the list leaves out is removed.

roleId.description: The role's PublicId (an ordinary role; a virtual role is refused).

scope.description: How far the role's permissions reach for the user.

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

oneOf.description: The users a virtual role reaches (int), or null.

permissions.description: The keys the role grants, sorted.

warnings.description: Warning codes of the write (`ACCESS_ONLY_BREAK_GLASS_MANAGES`); empty on a read.

RoleResponse.description: One role with its permissions (GET, POST and PUT of the roles routes).

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

isVirtual.description: True for a virtual role (never assignable).

oneOf.description: The users a virtual role reaches (int), or null.

permissionCount.description: How many permissions the role grants.

input.description: The wizard fields of the body.

draftStep.description: The step, or null when the body names none or an undefined one.

SaveServiceRequestDraftCommand.description:
The body of `PUT api/service-requests/{id}/draft`: the draft fields as the wizard holds them, plus the step
being saved. Only that step's fields are validated and written; the others are ignored (they keep what their own
step saved), so a stored draft never holds a field its step did not accept.

oneOf.description: The section's PublicId to update it, or null to add a new section.

bodyAr.description: The Arabic body (plain text, paragraphs separated by a blank line).

sortOrder.description: The display order, int PortalLimits.SortOrderMin to int PortalLimits.SortOrderMax.

number.description: The reference number, or null before the submit.

ServiceRequestDetailsResponse.description:
The fields of a service request for its detail cards. Every field but string? ServiceRequestDetailsResponse.Number and
string? ServiceRequestDetailsResponse.PreferredDate is set once submitted; the category names are null when the value was retired.

categoryId.description: The category value's PublicId token (family `lookup-items`), or null.

ServiceRequestDraftResponse.description: A draft as the wizard resumes it (every field null until its step is saved).

ServiceRequestInput.description:
The wizard fields as text, exactly as the client sends them (every one may be null or absent). The category is the
lookup value's PublicId token; the preferred date is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token (single use: every refresh returns a new one).

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: The idle timeout the client enforces, in minutes.

SessionResponse.description: The body of a successful login or refresh.

alg.description: Always `HMAC-SHA256`; an algorithm change is a visible wire change.

sessionSigningKey.description: The 32-byte derived session key, base64. Never the master.

audience.description: The audience every proof must carry (a signed field the client cannot guess).

verifyResponses.description: True when the server signs responses (response signing is not Off).

serverTimeUnix.description: The server clock, so the client can correct its skew.

SessionSigningKeyResponse.description: The signing block the client stores per session. Wire names are camelCase and fixed (the client reads them).

SessionUserResponse.description: A signed-in user as the client sees it.

isActive.description: True to offer the value again, false to retire it.

group.description: The group the screen lists it under.

valueType.description: How the value reads (integer on the wire).

updatedAt.description: When an administrator last changed it (ISO 8601 UTC), or null.

SettingResponse.description: One runtime setting on the wire (the bounds stay server-side; a value outside them is refused with a field error).

SettingValueType.description:
How a runtime setting's text value is read and validated. Stored and sent on the wire as the integer value; the
client labels it from its ar and en bundles.

SlaState.description: Where a record stands against the deadline of its current status (stored nowhere; sent as its int value).

ticket.description: The one-time ticket from the callback's URL fragment.

bindingProof.description: The binding secret whose hash started the sign-in (required: without it the ticket is rejected).

endSessionUrl.description: The identity provider's end_session URL; open it with a top-level GET (not fetch).

SsoLogoutResponse.description: The end of an SSO logout.

StatusWordingResponse.description: The status wording keys of one status, one per audience.

fullName.description: The sender's name (1-100 characters after trimming).

topicId.description: The contact topic: an active `contact-topics` lookup id (`ContactTopicIds`).

language.description: The language to reply in: `ar` or `en` (ContactLanguageCodes).

SubmitContactMessageCommand.description:
The body of `POST /api/portal/contact-messages`. Every member is nullable, so a missing field comes back as a
field error of the validator rather than as a binding failure in another shape.

SubmittedServiceRequestResponse.description: The answer of the submit endpoint.

actorDisplayName.description: The actor's name at the time.

fromStatus.description: The status before, or null for the first entry.

toStatusKey.description: The key of the status after.

action.description: The action key (one of the record's allowed actions).

reason.description: The reason, or null; the workflow decides whether it is required and how long it may be.

TransitionSide.description:
Which side of the counter takes a transition: the requester screens, the staff screens or a background job. The
allowed actions offered to a screen are those of its side. Values are stored and sent on the wire.

TriggeredJobRunResponse.description: The answer to "run now": the queued run's PublicId (its outcome appears in the run history).

count.description: How many of the caller's notifications are unread.

oneOf.description: Internal (1) or external (2); it cannot change while accounts belong to the organization.

UpdateOrganizationCommand.description: The body of `PUT /api/admin/organizations/{id}` (the same fields as a create).

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants after the write (replaces the set).

isActive.description: False deactivates the role (it then grants nothing; assignments stay).

confirmBreakGlassOnly.description:
True accepts that the write leaves only the break-glass administrator able to manage access (otherwise refused
with string AccessErrorCodes.LastManager).

UpdateRoleCommand.description: The body of `PUT /api/admin/access/roles/{id}`, validated by UpdateRoleValidator.

value.description: The new value as text, in the setting's format (see SettingValueFormat).

displayName.description: The name shown in the shell and the lists.

email.description: The e-mail address (unique when given), or null.

loginName.description: The directory login name (unique when given), or null.

upn.description: The user principal name (unique when given), or null.

oneOf.description: Internal (1) or external (2).
Password (1), Active Directory (2) or SSO (3).
The organization; required for an external user.

UpdateUserCommand.description: The body of `PUT /api/admin/users/{id}` (the user name never changes).

ticketHeader.description: The header the browser sends it in (and the only header the attachment service reads).

uploadUrl.description: The absolute upload URL on the attachment service.

maxFileCount.description: How many more files of the type the record may take.

roles.description: The assigned ordinary roles with their scopes.

permissions.description: The direct grants with their scopes.

virtualRoles.description: The virtual roles that match the user's kind.

warnings.description: Warning codes of the write; empty on a read.

UserGrantsResponse.description:
The body of `GET` and `PUT /api/admin/access/users/{userId}/grants`: the editable rows (roles and direct
permissions), the virtual roles that reach the user, and what the user holds now with every source.

UserKind.description:
Who a user is to the organization running the portal. Stored and sent as the integer value; labels come from the
client's i18n bundles, never from the member names.

total.description: The number of matches on every page.

loginName.description: The directory login name, or null.

upn.description: The user principal name, or null.

oneOf.description: The organization's PublicId, or null.

organizationName.description: The organization's name in the request language, or null.

hasPassword.description: True once a password-bound account has set its password through the activation link.

isLockedOut.description: True while failed sign-ins keep it locked.

isBreakGlass.description: True for the configured break-glass administrator.

UserResponse.description: An account as the admin screens see it (never a password, hash or ticket).

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

VirtualRoleResponse.description: A virtual role that reaches the user.

id.description: The record's PublicId (family `records`; opens the record detail).

statusKey.description: The status's wire key (the client builds the i18n key from it).

submittedAt.description: When the record was first submitted.

oneOf.description: Who holds the record, or null.
The SLA badge, or null.

total.description: The number of matching records on every page.

WorkflowAudience.description:
Who reads a status: each audience has its own wording for the same status (the requester sees "With the team",
staff see "Under review"). Values are stored and sent on the wire; never renumber a member.
